title: kornia/kornia: geometric computer vision in PyTorch, still climbing after the 23 October release
friendlyTitle: kornia/kornia: computer vision math for PyTorch, still climbing after the 23 October release
summary: Kornia is a Python library for geometric computer vision, aimed at spatial AI. Release v0.9.0, on 23 October, is described as more correct, faster to compile, and better on half-precision, Apple's MPS, and CUDA. GitHub's Python trending list showed 412 stars today, and about 12,100 in total.
friendlySummary: Kornia is a Python library for the geometry of computer vision, built for spatial AI. Release v0.9.0, on 23 October, is described as more correct, faster to compile, and better with half-precision numbers, Apple's MPS, and NVIDIA's CUDA. GitHub's Python trending list showed 412 stars today, and about 12,100 in total.
whyItMatters: Use it when camera or image geometry has to stay inside a PyTorch training loop, instead of leaving for a separate vision tool and coming back. It is a library for that job, not a chat prompt. The 23 October release is the one the daily list is still picking up.
